df.head()

# Check the value of DATA_PATH
DATA_PATH

import os

# Check the current working directory
current_directory = os.getcwd()
current_directory

# List the contents of the 'data' directory
data_directory = os.path.join(current_directory, 'data')
os.listdir(data_directory)

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv(data_directory + '/dataset.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
df.head()

# Check for missing values in the 'gene_expression_s1_noisy' column
missing_values = df['gene_expression_s1_noisy'].isnull().sum()
missing_values

from scipy import stats

# Drop the missing value
df_cleaned = df.dropna(subset=['gene_expression_s1_noisy'])

# Separate the data into two groups based on gender
group_male = df_cleaned[df_cleaned['gender'] == 1]['gene_expression_s1_noisy']
group_female = df_cleaned[df_cleaned['gender'] == 0]['gene_expression_s1_noisy']

# Perform a t-test
t_statistic, p_value = stats.ttest_ind(group_male, group_female, equal_var=False)
t_statistic, p_value

# Check the contents of both groups
group_male_values = group_male.values
group_female_values = group_female.values

len_male = len(group_male_values)
len_female = len(group_female_values)

len_male, group_male_values, len_female, group_female_values

# Check the unique values in the 'gender' column
unique_genders = df['gender'].unique()
unique_genders

# Count the occurrences of each unique value in the 'gender' column
gender_counts = df['gender'].value_counts()
gender_counts

# Recode the 'gender' column
df['gender'] = df['gender'].replace({-0.044642: 0, 0.050680: 1})

# Drop the missing value again
df_cleaned = df.dropna(subset=['gene_expression_s1_noisy'])

# Separate the data into two groups based on the recoded gender
group_male = df_cleaned[df_cleaned['gender'] == 1]['gene_expression_s1_noisy']
group_female = df_cleaned[df_cleaned['gender'] == 0]['gene_expression_s1_noisy']

# Perform a t-test
t_statistic, p_value = stats.ttest_ind(group_male, group_female, equal_var=False)
t_statistic, p_value
